title: OpenAI says GPT 5.6 is the ‘preferred model’ for Microsoft Copilot 365 amid breakup chatter

thread_text:
1. Is GPT-5.6 really better?

Microsoft bet its entire Copilot 365 stack on it — now OpenAI might walk away.

2. Microsoft picked a side.

Copilot 365 uses GPT-5.6 as its default model. That decision locks in a vendor.

3. Split rumors shake the deal.

If OpenAI and Microsoft separate, GPT-5.6 could lose its privileged access. Your stack changes overnight.

4. Bet on the right stack.

5. Test before you renew.

Run your own prompt set on GPT-5.6 and two alternatives. Which gives fewer edits per output?
